description: This SCSS file defines functions and mixins related to responsive design breakpoints in a CSS framework, including handling minimum and maximum widths and media queries for various device sizes.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Returns the name of the next breakpoint after the given name within the list of breakpoints.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width of the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Returns the maximum width of the specified breakpoint, adjusted by 0.02px to account for CSS media query limitations.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Returns a string used as a suffix in class names, empty for the smallest breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Applies styles for viewports at or above the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-down
methods.description: Applies styles for viewports up to the specified breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-only
methods.description: Applies styles exclusively within the specific breakpoint range.
